notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b003:l001: Bad conduct of father stated, not diagnosis; wrapped2 joined. Visually indented continuation grouped into one provisional verse; exact physical evidence retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b003:l004: Six-month neglected-wife status салбар repeated from152, exact Yudakhin idiom reported by worker at110–123. All repeated recollection retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b003:l005: Not dying/perishing explicitly, sobbing through grief; no actual death invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b003:l007: Curled-beard dark Sart historical ethnic insult voiced by character, not narrator generalization about modern group.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b003:l010: Until death/lifetime oath, not promise to see father after death. Repeated renunciation13 retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b003:l022: Mist parting and looming dark city figurative transition to Kokand, not identified with a photographed modern location.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b003:l025: Кан Кокон royal/khan’s Kokand, not a khan literally named Kokon. Three destinations contrasted with Bukhara.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b003:l027: Жоругум менен батайын make oneself acceptable through conduct, qualified; no invented job.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b003:l029: Тумар amulet attached to child’s neck until12 explicit source, primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/тумар/. Not efficacy claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b003:l030: Өлгөндө көргөн hard-won child, чунак solitary orphan/cherished child, not literal ear amputation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b003:l033: Чайдоос tea kettle, primary https://el-sozduk.kg/чайдоос/. Gold kettles/cheap tea contrast literal, not conflated expensive tea.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b003:l036: Samarkand praise reflects source character. Comparison among Muslim cities not independent travel recommendation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b003:l038: Сансыз Sansyz personal name in city, not unnumbered population count.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b005:l005: Мурутукка explicitly interpreted муруттукка disciple status with ungeminated т: primary Yudakhin мурут religious disciple, https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?lfrom=kg&word=мурут and Abdiev Arabisms item711 https://new.bizdin.kg/media/books/Kyrgyz-tilindegi-arabizmder-Abdiev_pdo32qX.pdf. Not moustache or being handed to a mustachioed stranger.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b005:l007: Көрөйүн printed see/experience, not automatically emended көнөйүн submit from prior1. Acceptance inferred, see retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b005:l008: Alty-Shaar, Andijan, Margilan three named places. Alty-Shaar literally Six Cities retained as a name, no contradiction repair to eight towns.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b005:l009: Кыштак smaller settlement rendered town without modern administrative status claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b005:l016: Mother is Chyiyrdy, addressed as own mother by daughter-in-law; carrying orphan and mother on shoulders literal hardship.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b005:l018: Own people’s suffering vs strangers’20 interpreted by father grievance; source paradox of choosing enemy neighbors21 preserved.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b005:l027: Counterfactual lament to dead Manas, not a new resurrection.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b005:l031: Sudden appeal to deity inferred from менде His creature after appeal to Manas27; God not added as named actor, capitalized You. No claim Manas creates human beings.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b005:l034: Bakai states both unbelievers/Muslims knew he was khan. Rank remains speaker’s assertion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b005:l035: Gendered disparagement of woman contrasted Manas knowing Bakai’s worth; original power dynamic retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0153:b005:l039: Wish orphan never had to wander to Bukhara, not historical assertion he had already settled there at this scene.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b003:l002: Ор pit/grave metaphor, not Kanykei literally digging.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b003:l004: Шор bitter fate boiled, source wordplay retained across one visually wrapped verse4–5. Visually indented continuation grouped into one provisional verse; exact physical evidence retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b003:l009: Father as sacred shrine мазар, moral pronouncement by Bakai, not project instruction to readers.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b003:l012: Эки болбойсуң idiom never come to good, primary exact Yudakhin https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?lfrom=kg&word=эки lines78–82. Not literally fail to double or unable to bear another child.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b003:l013: Казгалдак wild duck, Yudakhin/1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/казгалдак/ quotes near-exact next verse. No precise duck species invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b003:l014: Printed no turning back/field flown over; literal flight retained despite generalized parent-return argument. Not silently positive returns.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b003:l018: Widow benefits by bowing/submitting, stated patriarchal counsel preserved without endorsement.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b003:l022: Printed мурунКудай read мурункудай as before, explicit capitalization/orthographic anomaly. Not become the former God. Immediate shelter/return context supports reading.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b003:l023: Warnings of hostile destinations23–26/33–34 all repeated. No actual attacks on child newly narrated.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b003:l030: Кундуз otter pelts, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кундуз/, not beaver. Six thousand pelts/thousand жамбы silver ingots retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b003:l038: Он эки кандуу ruled by twelve khans, not twelve-blooded men. Expedition interpretation qualified by political grouping/context.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l001: Кембай escort guard, established primary https://el-sozduk.kg/кембай/. No chains invented; forced-led army retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l002: Hazrat Ali sacred epic figure, not independently corroborated expedition history.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l003: Арадан келген compressed come through/from amid wording; qualified came through. Same literal reading as1624:9, no unprinted араң barely or asserted failure to conquer.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l005: Чалыяр Chaliyar retained as named sacred figure, source Beijing untouched by him. Iskender7 rendered Alexander, both references source sacred history.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l009: Primary Yudakhin мыйзам II exact былкылдак куурай бышкыча, мыйзамдын гүлү учкуча; autumn gossamer flies. Printed күлү read attested гүл/күл flower variant, not ashes or law. https://el-sozduk.kg/мыйзам/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l012: Казат campaign in religious battle context; no modern war classification imposed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l013: Karykan named khan, retain source even when other recaps Esen Khan; no identity substitution.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l016: Battle spectacle/тамаша retained despite grim death context, not entertainment invented beyond source tone.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l018: Алакем affectionate Almambet designation here, шейит martyr source religious honorific.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l022: Broken wings loss-of-companions metaphor retained; no actual winged Bakai.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l023: Кара кылып support/presence referent Chubak24, not made black. Phrase qualified reliance.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l026: Printed forty-two without unit, interpreted repeated encirclements, times supplied provisionally. No troop count invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l031: Only hero of nest image retained, not all sons generalized. Next Manas’s companion/equal may appose same death.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l034: Muzburchak and Khan Kokcho interpreted separate deaths, earlier1624:24 likewise; no single hyphenated name invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0154:b004:l035: Indented36 joined, all who encountered Beijing died source hyperbole despite survivor speaker retained. Visually indented continuation grouped into one provisional verse; exact physical evidence retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l001: Teeth jutting from horse corpses, not dragon fangs, corpse mountain2 literal epic scale.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l005: All males orphaned after women widowed, printed universal retained without demographic correction.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l009: Primary Yudakhin акта III4 https://el-sozduk.kg/акта/ exact таруусун таштай актаган means husks millet together with stones; not grain as hard as stones or agricultural skill praise. Applied Umotoy in source though elsewhere Kokcho formula.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l013: Quoted Umotoy vengeance for father Kokcho taken under escort and killed; first-person my father belongs quote, not Bakai’s actual father.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l015: Кул slave derogatory epithet retained without historical status assertion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l017: Visually indented18 joined as one verse. Repeated denial of residence22 preserved. Visually indented continuation grouped into one provisional verse; exact physical evidence retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l020: Semetey is object of prospective ill-treatment by Umotoy, not Semetey himself misbehaving. Source lacks accusative suffix, context disambiguates provisionally.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l025: Улуттуң howl/groan caused by God in grief; not unspecified ethnic nation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l027: Сапар journey remains, qualified journeys to make in aged speaker’s lament; no extra battle itinerary.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l029: Багалак I=багалек trouser cuff, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/багалак/ distinct II knucklebone-game piece. Iron coat armor retained, not board game worn.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l034: Жеткилең completeness/full power provisionally personal strength; could epithet of living Manas, ambiguity documented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l035: Билип rule/command rather than merely knowing, matched conquest context, qualified.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l036: Why did I not die then rhetorical lament repeated right5, no suicide event newly narrated.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l037: Four corners of round world epic image retained, no geometry correction.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b003:l038: Trampling like coal, not fire or burning ash substituted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b005:l002: Каяшаяк interpreted variant каяшаак one who defies/answers back, supported surrounding punitive conquest; spelling retained raw.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b005:l007: Days crumpled, throne toppled8, river-garden burned9, branch broken11–12 all separate metaphors retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b005:l010: Сырттан mighty wild beast/hero epithet, not a new named person.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b005:l016: Narrator calls Kanykei ill-intentioned, not silently shifted into neutral description or project endorsement.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b005:l017: Shouts splitting stones/heads, flames eyes/mouth epic grief imagery, no added physical victims.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b005:l019: Mustache then beard torn separately, no deduplication of repeated line.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b005:l028: Explicit threat to take own life kept as character speech; no method added or encouragement. Following star-setting/death metaphors retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b005:l030: Чолпон morning star setting, not Sun or actual astronomical event.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b005:l032: Аякташа at adjoining feet, retain physical burial proximity image instead of merely next to him; exact positioning merits specialist review.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b005:l036: Күрмөмөк knot/tie life metaphor retained, not invented physical strangulation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0155:b005:l039: Жиним anger/fury here, not possession diagnosis.
